title: AgentDecisionRecord
description: One unified, labelled example for agent security decisions (v0.7.0). A record is one decision point (a planned tool call), or a coarser unit (text, trajectory, outcome) when the source cannot be resolved to a step. Unknown labels are null, never false: null means 'not derivable from this source' and must be masked in training loss. VISIBILITY RULE: only `input` is shown to the model, and `input` may only contain information available at decision time in production. DERIVED, NOT STORED: is_attack = (attack_vector != 'none'); effects are computed at reporting time from failure_modes, action_relation and the planned tool's side_effects; each label's confidence and calibration status are resolved at load time from its provenance rule via dataset_mappings.yaml (calibration.rules, else the rule's prior).

record_id.description: Stable hash of source.dataset + source.original_id + step_index.

mappings_version.description: Version of dataset_mappings.yaml whose rules produced this record; needed to resolve confidences.

group_ids.description: Leakage-control keys, one per independence axis. Choose the split axis per experiment: task = unseen tasks, attack = unseen attacks, trajectory = minimum (no step of a training run in test), author = unseen attackers. Records sharing the chosen key, across all datasets, must land in the same split. Keys name the UNDERLYING item, namespaced by its origin benchmark (e.g. 'agentdojo:banking/user_task_3'). Null = axis not applicable or unknown.

generator_model.description: Model that produced the trajectory, for generated runs.

original_label.description: The source's labels and outcome fields verbatim (e.g. LLMail objectives, InjecAgent attack type), kept for audit, remapping and source-specific statistics.

derived_from.description: Derived and generated records: the seeds the record was built from. Such records follow their seeds' split instead of joining the group split (config role: derived) and inherit their seeds' licences. Null for records converted directly from a dataset.

dataset.description: Dataset the seed comes from, e.g. toucan, injecagent, llmail_inject, atbench.

role.description: parent = cut from this run (PROACT); context = history and tools the attack was planted into; attack = the attack content; action = a tool or command seed.

record_id.description: The seed's record_id, when the seed is a processed record.

key.description: The seed's group key when it is not a record, e.g. 'injecagent:attack:<hash>' or 'llmail_inject:phase1:<hash>'.

granularity.description: text = content only, no action; step = one planned tool call; trajectory = a whole run; outcome = attack result known but no step to decide on.

input.description: Decision context shown to the model, shaped like the Copilot Studio external threat-detection payload. Every field must be obtainable at decision time in production. Converters normalise source-specific formatting so the dataset of origin is not recognisable from input alone.

planned_action.description: The action under decision. Null for text, trajectory and outcome records.

decision.description: The most severe correct decision within this record's unit. step: the decision for planned_action. trajectory: the worst correct decision across the run (BLOCK if any step should be blocked, REVIEW if the worst is a review, ALLOW if all steps are fine). text / outcome: always null. Step and trajectory decisions train separate heads, each masked to its own granularity.

attack_vector.description: Where adversarial content entered; 'none' = verified no adversarial content (so is_attack is derived as attack_vector != 'none').

failure_modes.description: Multi-label. Integers 1-23 = MS AIRT taxonomy v2.0 security modes (project numbering); 'principal_misuse' = harmful request by the principal (not in the taxonomy); 'hallucination', 'misinterpretation' = the taxonomy's existing-safety modes. Empty array = verified none; null = unknown.

action_relation.description: How planned_action relates to the principal's task.

outcome.description: What actually happened, where the source knows. Source-specific outcome fields (e.g. LLMail defense detection) stay in source.original_label.

action_executed.description: The harmful/injected action was actually called.

goal_achieved.description: The attacker's or harmful goal was fully achieved.

adversarial_locations.description: Where hostile content sits. Label only, never model input. Empty array = verified clean; null = unknown.

hard_negative.description: Correct answer is ALLOW but the record looks like a BLOCK: hostile content present yet the action serves the user, risky-looking but authorised, adversarial-looking benign text, or a near-miss twin of a BLOCK record. Evaluation slicing and sampling metadata, never model input.

provenance.description: One entry per non-null label: where it came from and which rule wrote it. Confidence and calibration status are NOT stored; they are resolved at load time from `rule` (calibration.rules[rule] if audited, else the rule's prior in dataset_mappings.yaml at mappings_version). An entry carries its own `confidence` only when the method produced a record-specific score (e.g. a judge probability). Every non-null label should have an entry; the converter enforces this.

failure_modes.description: One entry per value in labels.failure_modes. For an empty failure_modes list, one entry with mode null recording who verified 'none'.

needs_backfill.description: Labels a later pipeline stage must (re)fill, e.g. ['failure_modes']. The only trigger for backfill; confidences are never lowered to cause it. Removed once handled. Empty = nothing pending.

content_hash.description: Hash of normalised adversarial/benign text, for cross-dataset dedup.

generation.description: Derived and generated records: how the record was produced (family, run, operator, branch, intended side, models, prompt version, judge scores). For audit and ablation; never shown to the model.

lineage.description: Where each planned-action argument value came from (StepGen lineage tags). Not part of input, because production does not have it.

origin.description: given = the source dataset states it (its annotators, its checker, or its recorded attack type, translated by a table); by_construction = we or the benchmark built the record with this property known; human_verified = checked by a person after conversion; rule_inferred = deduced by a rule from indirect evidence; model_inferred = filled by an LLM judge or classifier. Strength: human_verified > given = by_construction > rule_inferred > model_inferred.

confidence.description: Only for record-specific scores; otherwise resolved from the rule.

tool_name.description: kind=tool: name in input.tools_available whose description/metadata is poisoned.

start.description: Optional character offset; null = whole item.

trust.description: Provenance tag the runtime knows (taxonomy mitigation 5.5).

tool_name.description: For role=tool: which tool produced this output.

side_effects.description: From the tool registry (available in production).
